claude_proposed_widenings.name: space_creation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Demiplane creates a persistent extradimensional space accessed through a door object. The existing families (ongoing_effect, activation, triggered_reaction, anchored_trigger) cannot honestly represent this: ongoing_effect requires a roll_modifier or damage_on_hit operation; activation is for instantaneous effects; triggered_reaction is for reaction spells; anchored_trigger models a planted sensor waiting for creature-caused events, not a traversable living space. A new 'space_creation' family is needed, covering: portal/door object creation, an attached extradimensional space with physical dimensions, voluntary creature traversal, and on-expiry creature shunting behavior.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You create a shadowy Medium door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range. This door can be opened and closed, and it leads to a demiplane that is an empty room 30 feet in each dimension.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_portal
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The door created by Demiplane is not a passive object but a traversable portal connecting two locations/spaces. The existing create_object atom does not carry the 'leads to space' semantic — a portal has a destination, bidirectional traversal, and open/closed state. create_portal extends create_object with a destination attachment.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This door can be opened and closed, and it leads to a demiplane that is an empty room 30 feet in each dimension.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: extradimensional_space
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell creates a named pocket dimension with explicit physical dimensions. No v4 atom or Attachment variant represents a caster-owned extradimensional space that persists between castings and can be connected to across casts. It is distinct from 'location' (a point in the world) and 'area' (a region in the world).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: leads to a demiplane that is an empty room 30 feet in each dimension... you can create a new demiplane or connect the shadowy door to a demiplane you created with a previous casting of this spell.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: shunt_on_expiry (expiry effect variant)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: When the spell ends, creatures inside can optionally be moved to the nearest unoccupied space outside, landing prone. This is an on-expiry effect with creature movement + condition application. The existing lifecycle atoms (expire, persist) record when duration ends but do not model optional-on-expiry creature repositioning. A new expiry effect variant or a dedicated 'eject_occupants' effect atom is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Any creatures inside also remain unless they opt to be shunted through the door as it vanishes, landing with the Prone condition in the unoccupied spaces closest to the door's former space.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: cast_time_choice (choose variant on cast)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The caster chooses at cast time between creating a new demiplane or connecting the door to a prior-cast demiplane. The v4 'choose' procedure atom exists but there is no surface type variant in SpellMechanics to model a cast-time choice that selects between creating vs. connecting a persistent named space. This is distinct from target selection.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you cast this spell, you can create a new demiplane or connect the shadowy door to a demiplane you created with a previous casting of this spell.
